title: Nutrition
examples: What are the main food groups I should eat?
Can you explain what nutrients do for our bodies?
How do I make sure my diet is balanced?

explain.say: Today we are learning about food groups for a balanced diet.

draw.text: Food Groups: What do they do?

explain.say: Now let me show you the real thing in 3D: a healthy plate. Look at the vegetables, the fruit and the grains. Tap any part, and I will tell you what it does.
Next we will look at the different nutrients our bodies need to grow.
A balanced diet means eating from all these different groups every day.
For an everyday example think about making a healthy lunch box today.
A common mistake is only eating snacks like crisps and sugary drinks.

draw.text: Mistake: Too much sugar, not enough balance.

explain.say: Remember that eating a variety of foods keeps your body strong and healthy.

items: This gives you many different nutrients.
A balanced diet is key to good health.

faq.q: Why do we need protein in our diet?
faq.a: Protein is very important because it helps your body build and repair tissues.
asks: Do I need protein to grow?
Where do I find protein sources?

faq.q: What is the difference between nutrients?
faq.a: Nutrients are the substances in food that your body needs to survive and function well.
asks: Are vitamins and minerals the same?
What are the main types of nutrients?
Do I get nutrients from everything I eat?

faq.q: How can I know if my diet is balanced?
faq.a: You can check if you are eating from all the main food groups each day.
asks: Do I need to count my food groups?
Is eating vegetables enough for balance?

faq.a: They are okay sometimes, but they do not give you the nutrients you need for energy.
asks: Are sugary drinks bad for me?
What is better than fizzy drinks?

faq.q: What is the best source of energy?
faq.a: Complex carbohydrates found in whole grains give you slow and steady energy.
asks: What gives me energy for playing?
Should I eat sugary snacks for energy?

facts: Fruits and vegetables provide essential vitamins and minerals.
Proteins are necessary for the growth and repair of muscles.
A balanced diet includes foods from all major food groups.
Whole grains provide sustained energy compared to refined grains.

quiz.say: Which food group provides the main source of energy for the body?
quiz.show: Carbohydrates are the main energy source.
quiz.why: Grains, like wholemeal bread, are rich in complex carbohydrates which give steady energy.

wrong.0: Fats store energy, but carbohydrates are the body's preferred quick fuel.
wrong.1: Fruits are great for vitamins, but grains are the primary energy source.
wrong.3: Proteins are more for building and repairing body parts, not primary energy.

quiz.say: If you eat only meat and cheese, which nutrient are you missing?
quiz.show: You need more plant foods for vitamins.
quiz.why: Vitamins come mainly from fruits and vegetables, which you would be missing.

wrong.0: Cheese provides calcium, so this is not the main missing nutrient.
wrong.1: While you lack energy, the specific missing nutrient is vitamins.
wrong.3: You ate meat and cheese, which are good sources of protein.

quiz.say: When making a balanced meal, what should you try to include?
quiz.show: Aim for variety in every meal.

options.show: Only foods from your favourite group
options.say: Only foods from your favourite group

options.show: A mix of five different food groups.
options.say: A mix of five different food groups.

quiz.why: A balanced diet requires components from all major groups for complete nutrition.

wrong.0: Relying on one group leads to nutrient deficiencies.
wrong.2: This leaves out essential energy from grains and vitamins from produce.
wrong.3: Sweet foods often lack the necessary balance of nutrients.
